articles.title: The Ethereum Foundation unveils new 'Clear Signing' standard to stop users from approving malicious crypto transactions
articles.snippet: The move comes after billions in losses from phishing attacks and wallet drains, with Ethereum pushing to make transaction approvals safer and easier to understand.

articles.title: Privacy emerges as crypto’s next 'killer app,' with Arc, Canton and Tempo topping $1 billion in funding
articles.snippet: New fundraising rounds for three institution-focused blockchains show how regulation, privacy and corporate competition are reshaping crypto infrastructure, according to Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan.

articles.title: France’s central banker Beau clashes with Lagarde over private digital euro plans
articles.snippet: France’s central bank deputy governor told CoinDesk public and private European entities need to get involved in digital asset development, diverging sharply from Christine Lagarde’s stance.

articles.title: EBay rejects GameStop’s $56 billion bid, putting bitcoin exposure back in focus
articles.snippet: The online marketplace's board called the half-cash, half-stock offer "neither credible nor attractive" Tuesday.

articles.title: Kraken parent, Franklin Templeton to develop onchain investment products
articles.snippet: The partnership will focus on tokenized yield products, blockchain-based funds and institutional crypto markets.
